OFFER LETTER — Example Gulf Trades (fictional), recruiting licence DEMO-RA-021. Office: Suite U, Example Avenue, Demo Nagar. Employer: Example Electrical Works (fictional), UAE. Role: electrician; monthly wage AED 2,400. Employment visa approved before departure. Service charge Rs 30,000 plus GST Rs 5,400, total ₹35,400; bank transfer with itemised receipt. Employer, recruiting agent and worker sign a tripartite contract before departure. Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) insurance policy will be provided before travel. Worker retains original passport.
